title: CreateBatchContextDetails
description:
The data to create a batch context.
If the value for a collection is absent or is explicitly provided as null, it will be converted to an empty value, i.e. "[]" or "{}" in json notation. This applies to nested collections as well.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only the String type is supported.

Key-value pair representing a defined tag key and value, scoped to a namespace.

Example: `{"CostCenter": "42"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
For more information, see [Resource Tags](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Operations": {"CostCenter": "42"}}`

description.description: Summarized information about the batch context.

displayName.description:
A user-friendly name. Does not have to be unique, and it's changeable.
If not specified or provided as null or empty string, it will be generated as "<resourceType><timeCreated>", where timeCreated corresponds with the resource creation time in ISO 8601 basic format, i.e. omitting separating punctuation, at second-level precision and no UTC offset. Example: batchcontext20250914115623.

entitlements.description: Mapping of concurrent/shared resources used in job tasks to their limits.

fleets.description: List of fleet configurations related to the batch context.

freeformTags.description:
Free-form tags for this resource. Each tag is a simple key-value pair with no predefined name, type, or namespace.
For more information, see [Resource Tags](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Department": "Finance"}`

jobPriorityConfigurations.description: List of job priority configurations related to the batch context.

CreateFleetDetails.description: Fleet configuration of the batch context.

type.description: Type of the fleet. Also serves as a discriminator for sub-entities.

CreateNetworkDetails.description: Network configuration of the batch context.

nsgIds.description: A list of [OCIDs](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of associated network security groups.

JobPriorityConfiguration.description: Job priority configuration to instruct the service on how to use priority tags.

tagNamespace.description: Name of the corresponding tag namespace.

values.description: Mapping of tag value to its priority.

weight.description: Weight associated with the tag key. Percentage point is the unit of measurement.

LoggingConfiguration.description: Logging configuration of the batch context.

type.description: Type of the logging configuration. Discriminator for sub-entities.
